project_type: FIND-U: Spring Boot 3.4.2 / Java 21 multi-module backend (microservices + lambdas) deployed to Railway, with a Vue/nginx frontend not in scope
language: Java 21 (config work is almost entirely YAML)
build_system: Gradle wrapper PER MODULE (each module has its own gradlew.bat and builds independently; there is no single root Gradle build that aggregates these services). Spring Cloud BOM 2024.0.0. Run gradle commands from inside each module directory.
test_framework: JUnit platform via Gradle (not exercised by this task; builds run with -x test)
build_command: .\gradlew.bat clean compileJava -x test --no-daemon  (run inside the module dir)
test_command: Not applicable; this task verifies via compileJava / bootJar with -x test
verification_instructions: Windows PowerShell. For each touched module, cd into the module directory and run `.\gradlew.bat clean compileJava -x test --no-daemon`; expect BUILD SUCCESSFUL. For ARCHITECTURE/findu-api-gateway and SECURITY/findu-spring-security also run `.\gradlew.bat clean bootJar -x test --no-daemon` to confirm packaging. Grep is NOT acceptable as verification.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Work directly on branch develop in c:\Users\ADMIN\Documents\FIND-U-PROJECT\findu (there are pre-existing uncommitted changes). Do NOT create a worktree or new branch. Each module builds standalone via its own gradlew.bat; do not assume a root aggregate build.
contribution_requirements: DO NOT change business logic or Java code except the ONE allowed mechanical change in findu-core (extract hardcoded URL to a @Value property). Everything else is application-qa.yml work. Never remove `config.import` lines or `@EnableDiscoveryClient` annotations. Never hardcode hosts — all connections via env vars. Do NOT set AWS *_ENDPOINT variables (those are LocalStack-only; omit so real AWS is used).
key_patterns:
Standard qa Eureka-disable block (add only where the eureka-client dependency exists):
  eureka:
    client:
      enabled: false
      register-with-eureka: false
      fetch-registry: false
Always set server.port: ${PORT:<Dockerfile EXPOSE port>} in qa so Railway injects PORT. Postgres JPA via SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL/USERNAME/PASSWORD with spring.sql.init.mode: never and ddl-auto: none. Redis via spring.data.redis.host/port (Spring Boot 3 location, as in the security reference). RabbitMQ via RABBITMQ_HOST/PORT/USERNAME/PASSWORD. MongoDB via SPRING_DATA_MONGODB_URI. Gateway routes use ${<X>_SERVICE_URI:http://<svc>.railway.internal:<port>} and discovery.locator.enabled: false. STYLE REFERENCE (do not break): SECURITY/findu-spring-security/src/main/resources/application-qa.yml.
relevant_files: SECURITY/findu-spring-security/src/main/resources/application-qa.yml (STYLE REFERENCE — already correct; only add Eureka-disable block)
ARCHITECTURE/findu-api-gateway/src/main/resources/application.yml (base routes with lb:// to rewrite in qa)
directory_structure: ARCHITECTURE/ holds findu-api-gateway (8080), findu-config (Config Server, not deployed to Railway), findu-eureka-server (not used on Railway). SECURITY/ holds findu-spring-security (8081, R2DBC) and findu-autorization-server-oauth2 (9595, JPA). CORE/ holds findu-core (8082), findu-transaction (EXPOSE 8084, base yml 8086), findu-help-v2 (8085, Mongo+S3), findu-notification-processor (8083, Rabbit+Redis+AWS). CORE/LAMBDA/ holds findu-notification-dispatcher (9000, Rabbit+Redis+WS), findu-transaction-daily-balance (EXPOSE 8089, base yml 8087), findu-transaction-provider-payout (skeleton, port 8088), findu-transaction-refund (skeleton, port 8089).

spring-security.note: qa.yml already exists; only add Eureka-disable block
